svg.title: Shift S2.4 — compact body and foot contact trace
svg.desc: Left original source crop embedded byte for byte. Right frontal 2D projection calculated from the S2.3 triangle mesh using the S2.4 lower-body transforms. The dome and facial graphics have not been resized. This is NOT a Chromium render or animation acceptance.

g.text: Both wedge feet touch y=0 in rest pose
